_README: ⛔ DO NOT 'CORRECT' THE `outside` NUMBERS BACK. READ THIS FIRST.
`outside` was RE-BASELINED on 2026-09-21 (edu-replatform Phase 03 slice C), by explicit user
ruling, from svg 61.9 / radicand 61.1 to svg 71.2 / radicand 70.3.
WHY THE OLD VALUES WERE WRONG:
They were captured while the app loaded Tailwind from https://cdn.tailwindcss.com, which
generated CSS AT RUNTIME by watching the DOM. A-G18's probe injects its subtree and measures
it immediately, so it measured the element BEFORE the CDN had generated the arbitrary-value
class `text-[1.15em]` that the probe (and the real app, js/app.js:1532) puts on it.
The old baseline therefore recorded the browser default 16px, not the app's intent.
HOW THAT WAS PROVEN, not argued:
Against the post-build app, the SAME probe DOM was rendered twice:
WITH    text-[1.15em] -> font-size 18.4px, svg 71.2, radicand 70.3
WITHOUT text-[1.15em] -> font-size 16px,   svg 61.9, radicand 61.1  <- the old baseline, exactly
Reproducing the old numbers REQUIRED REMOVING a class the app genuinely carries.
Corroboration: 71.2/61.9 = 1.1502 and 70.3/61.1 = 1.1506 — the 1.15em factor, on BOTH numbers.
DERIVED TWICE, IN SEPARATE RUNS (a value captured once is how this happened in the first place):
run 2  2026-09-21T10:03:53Z  ->  svg 71.2  radicand 70.3   (identical)
⛔ `chrome` WAS NOT TOUCHED, and must not be. logo 32x32 / upload 24x24 / burger 24x24 are
A-G18's ACTUAL PURPOSE — proving the .katex-scoped height fix did not relayout app chrome.
All three measured UNCHANGED across the CDN->build swap and across both derivation runs.
